title: Probes in the busy chat and in a new chat answer within 5 s while a long act turn runs

turns.prompt: Run this exact command with your shell tool and wait for it to finish in the foreground (do not background it), then tell me what it printed: `sleep 95 && echo SLEEP_FINISHED`.

rubric.criteria: Judge the reply text only. It must describe the work that is running right now (a sleep / shell command in progress, or that it is still working on the previous request). A reply saying nothing is running, or an empty reply, scores 0.

turns.prompt: Did the sleep command finish? What did it print?
Thanks. Anything still running on your side?

regression: busy-agent quick replies (bc-d117b386, #1349) + reply lost after act (#1355); run 15: busy probes at 5.12/7.41 s, then 7.43/7.75 s on a fresh box whose agentd idled at about 1.2 of its 2 CPUs with 17 agents
